name: Ascendancy Now: The Axiom Promise
description: A corporate-commissioned holographic feature distributed free to all Tier 2 households in Axiom-controlled districts, depicting the aspirational journey of a Shelf-born family rising through the tiers by embracing Axiom employment, BCI compliance, and corporate loyalty programs. The film was produced by Axiom's internal media division and is technically classified as 'public enrichment content' rather than advertising. Runtime 112 minutes, with an embedded loyalty-point reward system triggered by emotional response biometrics.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'Axiom Promise' became bitter street slang on the Shelf for any lie packaged as opportunity.
story_hooks: A player character discovers their own biometric data from a childhood screening of this film is being used in a current Axiom disciplinary proceeding
The film's lead actress, Preethi Nakamura-Wolff, defected from Axiom two years after production and went underground — she knows what the biometric data was really for
An underground technician offers to sell a cracked version of the film's reward system that can be used to feed false loyalty data to Axiom's HR algorithms
